item_short_desc: Sabre Pepper Gel with Holster is an effective personal safety gel with optimal stopping power. Legal for sale in 50 States. NY, MA and HI require FFL for purchase.
description: Sabre Pepper Gel with Holster is an effective personal safety gel with optimal stopping power. Featuring a flip top and a gel formula that is less affected by weather conditions, like the wind, resulting in reduced blowback. The pepper gel contains approximately 10 one second bursts and has a shooting range up to 18 feet. Includes a convenient holster and has a 4-year shelf life. ISO 9001 Certified.
